content.description: Walkers is a Cardano NFT project with Game Fi elements, utilizing the move 2 earn model rewarding holders for the distance they have walked. Walker's holders will be rewarded for any distance walked. Walkers is a project that promotes a healthy lifestyle and gameFi experience through using the Walkers app. WalkersCNFT holders will be able to gain experiance and earn points which will then be available to swap for $WALKERS token which will be listed on Cardano DEXs.
